title: Frozen Coffee Drink, Nonfat, with Whipped Cream

content.title: About
content.content: Frozen coffee drink, nonfat, with whipped cream is a refreshing beverage made from cold espresso, skim milk, and a light airy whipped topping. Served as a thick frappe, it retains the coffee’s aroma and a delicate creamy taste while keeping fat content low.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The drink is a staple of summer menus in cafés, offering a cold yet coffee‑intense option.
The whipped topping is prepared from skim milk with a small amount of stabilizer to keep it light and fluffy.
Frozen coffee often serves as a base for dessert cocktails and ice‑cream‑like treats.
Coffee used is usually brewed 12–24 hours in advance to achieve optimal flavor and aroma.
Because it’s low‑fat, the beverage fits well into calorie‑conscious diets while delivering a creamy mouthfeel.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Coffee provides polyphenols that help combat free radicals and support cellular health.

items.title: Boosts energy
items.content: Caffeine increases alertness and concentration, especially useful on hot days.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Skim milk and light whipped topping keep the overall fat content low without sacrificing taste.

items.title: Source of calcium
items.content: Skim milk contributes calcium essential for strong bones and teeth.

items.title: Supports metabolism
items.content: Caffeine can slightly raise metabolic rate, aiding calorie burning.

items.title: Caffeine sensitivity
items.content: Some individuals may experience jitteriness, insomnia, or rapid heartbeat.

items.title: Milk allergy or lactose intolerance
items.content: People with dairy sensitivities should opt for a plant‑based alternative.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: If sweetened, consider the added sugar, especially for those managing blood glucose.

items.title: Cold shock
items.content: Very cold beverages can cause discomfort for those with sensitive teeth.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the frozen coffee in tall glasses with a straw. Sprinkle cocoa powder or cinnamon on top if desired. For a vegan version, replace the whipped cream with a plant‑based foam.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the prepared drink refrigerated and consume within 24 hours. Prepare the whipped topping just before serving to retain its airy texture. If freezing, store individual portions in airtight containers.
